sloka: पीत्वा मधु यथाकामं विश्रान्ता वनचारिणः ।किं शेषं गमनं तत्र सुग्रीवो यत्र मे गुरुः ।। ५.६४.१३ ।।।।
transliteration: pītvā madhu yathākāmaṁ viśrāntā vanacāriṇaḥ ।kiṁ śeṣaṁ gamanaṁ tatra sugrīvo yatra me guruḥ ।। 5.64.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "The vanaras of the forest have taken rest after drinking as much honey as they desired. What is left here to do? We have to go wherever Sugriva is."
